doc.title: Hal Galper interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 27, 2022

title: Opening chat about being a night person and birth year
summary: Rowe greets Galper, who says he is a night person after sixty years of the jazz life; he confirms he was born in 1938.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe and I’m really pleased to have Hal Galper with me this afternoon. And I recall you made a point that you don’t sort of come alive until the afternoon. After years of the jazz life.
Sixty years of the jazz life. My circadian rhythm is set. Try as I might I still end up going to bed 3:33 every morning. It cuts down my daytime but you know I’m a night person. What can I tell you.
Yeah. It’s okay with me. I’m not that much of a night person but I still — my circadian rhythm still goes to about midnight. I wanted to ask you, you were born in 1938, is that correct?
